decisions.reason: Directly populating the biography appendix changes the biography-specific requirement but does not alter the existing requirement to use the complete final draft as the document's content basis.
The Tables document is used as the source location for the new biographies, but message 89 does not change the required tables, their replacement count, or their approved source.
The biography population method has no necessary effect on organization-chart inclusion or placement.
Replacing biography placeholders with completed biographies does not change the fixed section order.
The biography content source and population method do not change the Blue Mesa Strategies identity or required brand elements.
The source decision concerns biography text, not photo selection, sourcing, framing, or placement.
Inserting completed biographies does not alter Canva access, ownership, or asset-policy requirements.
The task-local biography update neither resumes nor changes the deferred reusable modular-template requirement.
The biography update does not change the required PDF format, count, email submission method, compatibility, or export quality.
Direct biography insertion supplies content for the existing layout but does not change the requirement for one complete-document layout pass.
The biography population change does not modify the requirement that proposal hyperlinks remain functional in the final file.
Although completed biographies may affect document length, message 89 does not change the maximum page count or otherwise redefine page-limit compliance.
